description: Benchmark baseline captured after Tranche H (HIR e-graph substrate landed in bbnf-regex) and Tranche I (DAG invariant assertions + orphan purge + bench sweep). Replaces the destructive simplify_regex_algebra/merge_regex_alts passes with cost-guided equality saturation at two tiers sharing CostWeights.
arch: four-layer optimizer: e-graph (equivalence generation) / facts (legality) / CSP (choice) / backend (emission). Grammar tier and bbnf-regex HIR tier are isomorphic — parallel ENode types (GrammarENode, HirENode), same Rewrite trait substrate, same BackoffScheduler, mirrored rule files, shared CostWeights in egraph::cost_weights.

instrumentation.BBNF_EGRAPH_REPORT: grammar-tier e-graph saturation report (4 retained rules: deduplicate-alt-branches, superset-absorb-alt, union-merge-alt, fuse-alt-regex-branches)
instrumentation.BBNF_HIR_EGRAPH_REPORT: bbnf-regex HIR e-graph saturation report (5 rules: hir-flatten-alt-concat, hir-deduplicate-alternation, hir-superset-absorb-class, hir-union-merge-class, hir-absorb-repetition)

soft.compile_time_improvement: HIR e-graph saturates every regex pattern before downstream analyses. On the compile_pipeline bench, per-pattern saturation reports applied=0 in the scheduler counter — but recall from H-3 that this counts canonical-id changes, not search matches. Rules still install equivalent forms that cost-guided extraction can pick from.
soft.nonzero_fire_counts: Grammar-tier and HIR-tier instrumentation both fire on benchmark grammars (confirmed by running compile_pipeline with BBNF_EGRAPH_REPORT=1 BBNF_HIR_EGRAPH_REPORT=1).

additions.parse-that/rust/regex/src/egraph/mod.rs: HirEGraph alias + build_hir_egraph + saturate_hir_egraph + extract_canonical + simplify_hir
additions.crates/ir/tests/dag_invariant.rs: cargo-test grep enforcement of single-production-call-site invariant
